appendToPrompts.N: STRICT NORTH ATTACK PLANE: Keep torso, pelvis AND head squarely facing straight AWAY for all phases. No turn toward screen-right/left, no side face and no front breastplate. During downstroke phases 6-8, both hands and most of sword pass on the FAR side of the actor, so cloak/back naturally OCCLUDE them. Do not draw a diagonal sword down the screen-right side or a side-facing lunge. Strike toward screen-UP/away, not toward screen-right. Raised sword stays visible vertically above head in holds. For impact, show back shoulders/arms completing the forward-away chop with hands mostly hidden in front of chest on the far side; a blade tip may be visible beyond far shoulder, but never painted across the near back.
appendToPrompts.NE: STRICT NORTH-EAST ATTACK PLANE: Actor remains a REAR three-quarter view facing away toward screen-right. Head shows back/right profile sliver, not a front face. Strike forward-away toward screen-UP-RIGHT; torso/back cloak stays dominant, hands and part of blade can be hidden on the far side. Do not turn actor into east/front view or cut down-right across near legs. Match direction master.
appendToPrompts.NW: STRICT NORTH-WEST ATTACK PLANE: Actor remains a REAR three-quarter view facing away toward screen-left. Head shows back/left profile sliver, not a front face. Strike forward-away toward screen-UP-LEFT; torso/back cloak stays dominant, hands and part of blade can be hidden on the far side. Do not turn into west/front view or cut down-left across near legs. Match direction master.
appendToPrompts.W: STRICT WEST ATTACK PLANE: True LEFT-facing side profile in every phase. Blade swings forward toward screen-LEFT and downward; it must not point to screen-right during the strike. Do not change to right-facing profile or front view. Retain same anatomical dominant hand and the reference outfit.
appendToPrompts.SW: STRICT SOUTH-WEST ATTACK PLANE: Front three-quarter view facing screen-LEFT. Forward cut travels screen-DOWN-LEFT, not screen-right. Keep the same left-looking head/torso orientation and original hand anatomy.
appendToPrompts.SE: STRICT SOUTH-EAST ATTACK PLANE: Front three-quarter view facing screen-RIGHT. Forward cut travels screen-DOWN-RIGHT. Keep same right-looking head/torso orientation and original hand anatomy.
